questions.question: One mole of an ideal monatomic gas undergoes a cyclic process as shown in the figure. The total heat supplied to the gas is :
questions.diagram_description: p-V diagram with p in $N/m^2$ on vertical axis and V in $m^3$ on horizontal axis. A rectangular cycle a→b→c→d→a: a at (2, 300), b at (5, 300), c at (5, 100), d at (2, 100). Arrows: a to b rightwards along p=300, b to c downwards along V=5, c to d leftwards along p=100, d to a upwards along V=2 (clockwise cycle).

questions.question: Consider that an electron is revolving in an excited state of Hydrogen atom with velocity $\sqrt{25.6}\times10^{5}\ ms^{-1}$. The radius of the orbit is $x\times10^{-9}$ m. The value of $x$ is : (Take the mass of electron to be $9\times10^{-31}$ kg, charge of electron $= -1.6\times10^{-19}$ C and $\frac{1}{4\pi\epsilon_0} = 9\times10^{9}\ N\,m^2\,C^{-2}$]

A car travels on a circular racetrack of radius 50 m, which is banked at an angle $\theta$. If the car travels at a speed $10\ ms^{-1}$, then the wear and tear on its tyres is minimum. Taking the acceleration due to gravity to be $10\ ms^{-2}$, the value of $\theta$ is:

Three identical p-n junction diodes $D_1, D_2$ and $D_3$ are connected across a battery as shown in the figure. If the width of the depletion regions of $D_1, D_2$ and $D_3$ are $W_1, W_2$ and $W_3$, respectively, then the correct option is:
questions.diagram_description: Three parallel branches connected between a left node and a right node, across a 5V battery at the bottom. Top branch: 1kΩ resistor in series with diode $D_1$ pointing right (forward from left to right). Middle branch: 1kΩ resistor in series with diode $D_2$ pointing right, but the branch has an open gap (break) after $D_2$ before the right node. Bottom branch: diode $D_3$ pointing left (reversed) in series with 1kΩ resistor. Battery of 5V connects the left and right nodes.

questions.question: Bob B of mass $m$ at rest is hanging vertically from the ceiling via a massless string of length 10 m, as shown in the figure. Point mass A of mass $m$ travelling horizontally with speed $10\ ms^{-1}$ hits bob B elastically. The bob B rises $h$ meter after the collision. Taking the acceleration due to gravity $g = 10\ ms^{-2}$ and neglecting the size of the bob, the value of $h$ is :
questions.diagram_description: A vertical string hanging from a horizontal ceiling with bob B at its lower end. Point mass A to the left of B moving horizontally towards B with speed $10\ ms^{-1}$ (dashed arrow pointing right).

questions.question: An ideal gas is made of polyatomic molecules. Each of the molecules has three translational, three rotational and $f$ number of vibrational modes. If the ratio of heat capacities $\frac{C_p}{C_v}$ of the gas is $\frac{8}{7}$, then the value of $f$ is:
